corpus.content: Python 3.11 adds exception groups and task groups.
Python 3.12 improves the f-string parser and adds type parameter syntax.
Python 3.13 introduces a free-threaded build and an improved interactive interpreter.
Haystack pipelines connect document retrieval, ranking, and generation components.
Haystack in-memory BM25 retriever ranks documents by lexical overlap using BM25L.
ragrefine is a retriever-agnostic post-retrieval refinement library for RAG context.
Ragas computes faithfulness, context recall, and factual correctness for RAG answers.
Faithfulness measures how factually consistent a generated answer is with the retrieved context.
BEIR is a heterogeneous benchmark for zero-shot information retrieval evaluation.
SciFact is a scientific claim verification dataset used for retrieval benchmarking.
A cross-encoder scores query-document pairs jointly through a transformer model.
BM25 is a sparse lexical retrieval model that scores documents by term frequency and inverse document frequency.
Dense retrieval encodes queries and documents into fixed-size vector embeddings.
Near-duplicate passages are removed by normalized text hashing or token-shingle Jaccard similarity.
Reciprocal rank fusion combines multiple rankings by summing reciprocal ranks.
